“When life gets blurry, adjust your focus.”

Every photograph holds a little piece of time. A passing moment, a familiar feeling, a place that stays in your memory.

Through my lens, I try to notice the details that are often overlooked — changing skies, unfamiliar roads, quiet landscapes and the stories hidden in everyday life.

This is my space to collect those moments.
